scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mops/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @mops/api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mops/shared && npm run check:i18n && npm run build -w @mops/api && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mops/shared && npm run test -w @mops/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mops/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mops/api && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -b apps/web --pretty false
